title: Joe McMoneagle blind remote viewing of the same mountain bases
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Joe McMoneagle blind remote viewing of the same mountain bases, about after 1973 at Mount Perdido, Spain and other mountain sites, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Mount Perdido, Spain and other mountain sites

tellings.quote: Years later, Joe McMoneagle, another extremely talented remote [music] viewer, was given the same coordinates blind. He saw the same mountains with the same underground command centers. And then, he saw something else. The bases were connected like nodes of a network.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of remote viewing, the claimed ability to see distant places with the mind alone, as practiced in US government trials. He says that years after an earlier viewing in the 1970s, a gifted remote viewer named Joe McMoneagle was given the same map coordinates without being told what they were, and saw the same mountains, including Mount Perdido in Spain, with the same underground command centers. According to Michels, McMoneagle also saw that the bases were linked together like points in a network, which would suggest a hidden system of bases spread across the world.
